# CANDIDATE: RSI_STRUCTURE_DIVERGENCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Bullish RSI divergence at a swing low followed by a break of structure (higher high) yields a high-probability long. The divergence indicates weakening downward momentum, and the structure break confirms a shift in market bias, increasing the probability of an upward move.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: Identify the swing low (lowest low of the last 10 bars). If RSI(14) makes a higher low than the prior swing low while price makes an equal or lower low (bullish divergence) and price then closes above the prior swing high with volume > 1.2× the average volume of the last 5 bars, go long. Exit shape: Chart‑stop at the swing low (invalidates the structure), TP1 at 2R, runner trail using a 20‑period EMA trail. Regime hint: VIX between 12‑20 and time after 10:00 EST.
